lines.say: Ranking every way to revise maths.
Rereading the worked solution. F tier. You're watching, not doing.
Ten of the same question in a row. B. Feels good. Won't last.
Explaining it out loud, from a blank page. S.
Spaced flashcards on the methods. Also S.
Offload does both S tiers, from your own notes.
It plans the sessions, and moves them when your week changes.
You just click the link in your calendar.
